notes.title: Developer Update!
notes.content:
Kuroki Yume games has been quite silent for a while now. To be frank I had taken a short break but I have been recently working on a new project...



Currently codenamed "cabin" the new horror game is about 30% complete! Here are some in progress screenshots



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139410/d4aac1afb536c194ea3f8768098669e61733675f.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139410/92fda0602d6038088d24032c51db5b49a58c8778.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139410/7cd9e8d1f4eb81fd00b8955e4500ccd408d8563d.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139410/2ab7a858a77a159f2f05d67eddf000f64a8ca11c.png"]



Thank you for taking the time to read it! As promised your reward will be some keys to my other game "Tenshi" as well as some keys for "the Yamamura Estate". Of course if youre already a fan and happen to already own these games feel free to share them to your friends!
